knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)

#wczytanie strony
Otomoto <- read_html("https://www.otomoto.pl/osobowe/volvo")

#Analizujemy wyłącznie elementy, które mają atrybut data-id
car <- Otomoto |> html_elements(xpath = "//article[@data-id]")

data <- data.frame(
  Name = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//h2//a") %>% html_text2(),
  Price = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//h3") %>% html_text2(),
  Mileage = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//dd[@data-parameter='mileage']") %>% html_text2(),
  Fuel = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//dd[@data-parameter='fuel_type']") %>% html_text2(),
  Gearbox = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//dd[@data-parameter='gearbox']") %>% html_text2(),
  Voivodeship = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//li//p") %>% html_text2(),
  Year = car %>% html_element(xpath = ".//dd[@data-parameter='year']") %>% html_text2()
)

data
```
```{r}
#Funkcja do przyporządkowania NA w przypadku braków danych
get_value <- function(nodes, xpath) {
  out <- nodes %>% html_element(xpath = xpath) %>% html_text2()
  out[out == ""] <- NA
  out
}
```

```{r}
#Skrapowanie z uwzględnieniem braków danych
data_2 <- data.frame(
  Name = get_value(car,".//h2//a"),
  Price = get_value(car,".//h3"),
  Mileage = get_value(car, ".//dd[@data-parameter='mileage']"),
  Fuel = get_value(car,".//dd[@data-parameter='fuel_type']"),
  Gearbox = get_value(car,".//dd[@data-parameter='gearbox']"),
  Voivodeship = get_value(car,".//li//p"),
  Year = get_value(car,".//dd[@data-parameter='year']")
)

data_2
```
```{r}
volvo <- function(link){
  #Wczytywanie strony
  subpage_volvo <- read_html(link)
  
  #Wczytanie określonego ogłoszenia
  subpage_car <- subpage_volvo %>% html_elements(xpath = "//article[@data-id]")
  
  #scraping (zapis do data.frame)
  subpage_data <- data.frame(
    Name = get_value(subpage_car,".//h2//a"),
    Price = get_value(subpage_car,".//h3"),
    Mileage = get_value(subpage_car, ".//dd[@data-parameter='mileage']"),
    Fuel = get_value(subpage_car,".//dd[@data-parameter='fuel_type']"),
    Gearbox = get_value(subpage_car,".//dd[@data-parameter='gearbox']"),
    Voivodeship = get_value(subpage_car,".//li//p"),
    Year = get_value(subpage_car,".//dd[@data-parameter='year']")
  )
  return(subpage_data)
}
#test
test_1 <- volvo("https://www.otomoto.pl/osobowe/volvo?page=3")
test_1
```
```{r}
results_volvo <- list()

for(i in 2:30){
  print(paste("obecnie jesteśmy na stronie numer: ", i))
  
  specific_link <- paste0("https://www.otomoto.pl/osobowe/volvo?page=", i)
  
  volvo_scraping <- volvo(specific_link)
  
  results_volvo[(i-1)] <- volvo_scraping
}

OtoMoto_Volvo <- do.call(rbind, results_volvo)
OtoMoto_Volvo <- rbind(data, OtoMoto_Volvo)

write.csv(OtoMoto_Volvo, "OtoMoto_test.csv", row.names = F)
```
